ios.desc:
Wöör – Vocabulary & Dictionary for English Learning

Build powerful English vocabulary — with a smart dictionary and adaptive exercises.

Wöör helps intermediate and advanced learners grow a real, usable vocabulary that sticks. Perfect for professionals, students, exam takers, and anyone improving English.

Why Wöör:
Vocabulary builder + smart dictionary
Just add a word — Wöör finds trusted definitions, translations, usage notes, and real-life examples. No need to search in different apps or dictionaries.

Adaptive learning & spaced repetition
Flashcards, gap-fill, and review tasks are automatically created for your words. Wöör adapts to your level and helps you remember long-term.

Professional & academic focus
Learn vocabulary for work, study, or research. Great for software engineers, healthcare workers, scientists, lawyers, project managers, and creatives.

Exam preparation
Prepare for IELTS, TOEFL, OET, C1/C2, and other English tests. Master the vocabulary you need to succeed.

Custom word lists & collaboration
Build your own lists or use curated sets. Teachers and tutors can share specialized vocabulary with students or teams.

Multilingual support
Add English words and get translations in 22 languages: Arabic, Bangla, Belarusian, Chinese, Filipino, French, German, Hausa, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Punjabi, Russian, Spanish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese.

Terms of use: https://www.woor.app/termsofuse

quotes.text:
I built an app to help in improving English vocabulary:

https://www.woor.app/

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/woor-vocabulary/id6740453162

Initially started as small webapp to help me learn Dutch words. Made it out of the frustration that in Duolingo I cannot specify the words I want to learn and Quizlet exercising and progression felt limited. I also wanted to target the specific meanings of the words.

Then I decided to try out CapacitorJS and wrapped it into the mobile app. For now only English is available as the target language as it was easier to validate the content, but more languages are coming.

Along with it also started the podcast with language tutors about the teaching & tech. Please find the links here: https://www.woor.app/tutorandtech
